description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Dynamic, smart people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here. The people who work here have reinvented entire industries with all Apple Hardware products. The same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices strengthening our commitment to leave the world better than we found it. Join us to help deliver the next groundbreaking Apple product. As a member of our dynamic group, you will have the unique and rewarding opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and inspire millions of Apple's customers every single day.

Description
We are looking for a versatile engineer who can pick up any piece of it from scratch: an iOS app, a macOS tool, a data pipeline, a cloud service, an agentic workflow. You will help decide what we build, how we build it, and how we work together. You are not a specialist in one layer. You are the person who learns whatever the problem requires, integrates the systems that need to work together, and delivers a working solution end to end.

Responsibilities
Build software from scratch across macOS and iOS, primarily in Python and Swift, and see it through from first prototype to production.
Integrate diverse systems, devices, services, and tools, including ones that were never designed to work together.
Design and build agentic software: applications and workflows where LLM-based agents plan, call tools, and act, along with the guardrails and evaluation that make them dependable.
Build and operate cloud infrastructure and services on AWS.
Build data engineering pipelines, storage, transformation, orchestration, and the tooling that makes data usable for research and analysis.
Make advanced AI coding tools a core part of how you build and help set the standard for how a small team moves fast with them.
Participate in design and code reviews, and write clear, maintainable, well-documented code.

Minimum qualifications
BS or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Proficiency in Python and JavaScript with hands-on macOS Applications development experience.
Hands-on experience with AWS (e.g., S3, Lambda, IAM, Secrets Manager, managed databases) and cloud-based services.
Experience with advanced AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or similar.

Preferred qualifications
3+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production code across more than one domain or stack.
Experience integrating hardware, sensors, or devices, and debugging across the hardware/software boundary.
Web and dashboard development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or Python-based frameworks).
Infrastructure as code and security-minded practices for cloud systems (secrets management, least-privilege access).
Background in startups, research environments, or small teams.
Familiarity with machine learning workflows and inference integration.
Strong problem-solving skills and comfort learning new languages, frameworks, and domains quickly.
Fluent with git and modern development workflows (CI/CD, testing, code review).
